ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 65% of the visible surface, concentrated in the central lobes, contrasted with low-intensity black pixels covering 35% along the margins and median notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central white region is a continuous high-intensity block. Low-intensity black border follows the trailing edge and distal tips. Distinct low-intensity vertical streak (approx. 10 pixels wide) on the right lobe at roughly 70% width from the left tip. Dark mottling clusters located on the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees; depth extends approximately 15% into the vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of variations increases significantly at the distal tips, showing irregular peak-to-valley pixel transitions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-symmetrical convex curves sweeping laterally and upward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast yellowish-white clusters localized on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, indicating raised physical surface irregularities.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct near-vertical low-intensity linear disruptions on the right lobe; the largest originates at the trailing edge and extends approximately 40 pixels toward the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy concentration of high-contrast clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) localized exclusively on the outermost tips of both lobes.
